newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen moving down on labour strike.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen moving down on labour strike.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) are expected to decline on Wednesday as a strike by labour unions may cause thin trading, brokers said.
"We expect a poor turnout of investors because there are very few transports," said Mohammad Ashraf of Sabbir Ahmed & Company.

Another broker expressed doubt whether any trading would take place at all. "It's still uncertain. It depends on how many brokers will be able to reach (work)," he said. Labour unions are pressing for higher wages and a halt to the government's denationalisation programme. The DSE all-share price index dropped 45.31 points to 960.26 on Tuesday. -- Dhaka newsroom +880-2-506363
